report.summary: SEC'nin küçük işletmeler için yatırım modernizasyonu ve kredi kümeleri ile ilgili bir toplantıya çıkacağı duyuruldu. execution_market.runtime: source Electron with current Python engine

learning_review.scope: Learning, AI experiment isolation, worker recovery, chronological backtest execution

entry_bar_reproduction.baseline_source: The 0.7.1 source ZIP in outputs before the 0.7.2 delivery replaced it; engine/research.py executed in an isolated in-memory module
entry_bar_reproduction.scenario: Long entry 100, stop 98, target 104. Entry candle low 97. Next candle high 105. Starting capital 10000, zero fees and slippage to isolate execution ordering.
entry_bar_reproduction.interpretation: The old historical simulator skipped the entry candle range. The correction recognizes the adverse stop on that candle. This synthetic regression does not measure real trading performance.

checks: Unapproved AI experiments preserve the active statistical baseline, champion and initial scan bootstrap eligibility
Experimental queue is bounded, deduplicated and never accepts coefficients-less candidates as the live fallback
Persisted unapproved experimental latest models are quarantined; legitimately promoted champions and pending candidates remain; pending comparisons restart with fresh evidence
Twelve inference/training lifecycle combinations reject stale results after pause, mode/session change, AI/research disable or shutdown
A real spawned process terminates with os._exit(17); the next context trains successfully in a new pool without restarting the app
An older failed pool cannot detach a newer shared replacement
Long and short entry-bar stops are counted; simultaneous stop/target uses the adverse stop
An intrabar exit cannot finance a retrospective re-entry at that same candle's open
The 16-bar and 42-bar holding limits include the entry candle
Missing entry or held bars discard adaptive historical labels; already resolved labels remain valid
A gap within the latest80 raw bars blocks strategy options and returns an explicit unavailable/data-quality context; continuous inputs remain unchanged

limitations: Historical results generated without execution_model=bar-causal-v2 require rerunning; existing stored results must not be reinterpreted as corrected
This review verifies deterministic execution and lifecycle behavior, not profitability
Current signal continuity checks cover the most recent80 raw bars. Full higher-timeframe EMA continuity and older indicator history gaps require additional data-quality work

classification_dependency.failure_behavior: Binance spot discovery raises; the caller retains the last complete catalog. No incomplete stock classification is accepted.
